fato_historico: 1702: Anglo-Dutch forces, under the Duke of Marlborough and Earl of Athlone, capture Liège during the War of the Spanish Succession.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle conquest of your own heart. Much like the grand efforts of historical forces capturing strongholds, you are invited to reclaim your emotional security. It is a good time to fortify your inner world, creating a sanctuary where intuition blossoms and your sensitive spirit feels truly protected and deeply cherished.
frase_do_dia: Your heart is a kingdom worth defending with grace and tender strength.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of dreams through intuition and collective harmony.
conselho: Consider setting healthy boundaries to protect your radiant, beautiful energy today.
